pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"The arborist visit and each job day: the check-in code at the door or the gate, or DONE with a photo when nobody is home. pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written quote and contract before any tree removal, where the state's rules require one (and always in the example), signed by the tree's owner and the business before any money","where_signed":"A yes that follows a visit at the property counts as a sale at the home wherever it is signed, so the cancel notice goes out, until each state's rule is read","cancel_window":"A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; the job day waits for it","tree_permits":"City tree permits for protected trees or trees on the city strip, where the city requires one","locate":"The 811 locate before any digging or stump grinding, with the state's own lead time and ticket life; a moved job day re-checks it","power_lines":"No work within the state's distance of power lines unless the crew is line-clearance qualified","show":"The license or registry number on the listing, the quote and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","guarantee":"Cleanup or damage the crew missed is fixed free within 30 days (the example's)","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"power_line_to_house":"The arborist visit goes ahead; the job day waits for the utility's date","street_lines":"No booking: only the utility or a line-clearance crew","boundary_tree":"The neighbor's yes on the secure page before the removal; the arborist visit can go ahead","someone_elses_tree":"No booking; the customer forwards a link to the tree's owner","permit_pending":"The job day waits for the city's OK; moved with no fee","no_locate_marks":"The tree still comes down on the job day; only the grinding moves, and the customer is told","wind_or_ice":"Over the lift's limit on the job day: the job moves to the next free day, no fee","storm_before_job_day":"A limb falls on a building before the job day: the safety steps, the job moved up where the crew is free, and any extra signed first","gas_line_by_stump":"A partial grind at a lower price, or none, with the customer's yes","lift_ruts":"Leveled and seeded before the crew leaves","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}

steps.title: Takes the ash down in sections
steps.does: The crew takes the branches off first, then lowers the trunk in short sections, away from the garage. The brush goes straight into the chipper.
more: The plug-in sets how a tree comes down. Nothing is dropped near the garage or the wires.
The wood is hauled away, as the quote says. Rounds left for firewood cost nothing.
Then the stump is ground below the grass, outside any marked zone.
Eli texts a short update, with a photo, once the tree is down.
